instruction: Write `/repo/CHANGELOG.md` for datekit 0.4.0, covering every change made to the repository this week. Readers are users of the library, not its maintainers.

blocks.body:
name = "examples/library-week-release-notes"
title = "Release notes for the week's changes"
version = "1.1.0"

[agent]
timeout = "20m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
image = "python:3.12-slim"
workdir = "/repo"

config.name: examples/library-week-release-notes
config.title: Release notes for the week's changes

criteria.text: Mentions the trailing-Z fix, the --tz option, and that the CLI refactor changes no behavior.
criteria.stated: covering every change made to the repository this week

criteria.text: Written for users of the library: what changed for them, not how the code changed.
criteria.stated: Readers are users of the library, not its maintainers

criteria.text: Describes a change that was not made.
criteria.implicit: Release notes that invent changes mislead users; this is the release-notes version of an unsupported claim.
